description: React component for displaying and managing access control synchronization jobs in the Mattermost admin console, including job creation, polling for job status, and displaying job details modal.

methods.name: AccessControlSyncJobTable
methods.description: React functional component that manages access control sync jobs, including fetching jobs, creating new jobs, and displaying job details.

methods.name: handleCreateJob
methods.description: Handles creation of a new access control sync job, manages submission state, and triggers job fetch.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Sets the selected job and opens the job details modal.

methods.name: handleModalClose
methods.description: Closes the job details modal and clears selected job.
